newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's CSP green shoe option fully used.
newsitem.headline: Italy's CSP green shoe option fully used.

text.p: Italian hosiery company CSP, which made its Milan bourse debut on Wednesday, said its flotation global coordinator UBS had used the entire 1.37 million share green shoe option to satisfy extra demand for stock.
The offer earmarked for institutional investors was raised to 7.125 million shares and the total capital floated rose to 39.1 percent from 33.6 percent.
CSP made a euphoric bourse debut on Wednesday with the stock price touching a session high of 18,500 lire against its market placement price of 15,000 lire.
But on Thursday it closed 0.75 percent down at 17,869 lire on an easier stock market.
